title: Phase 5A: the three Opus 5.5 frontier recipes at 201,326,592 training tokens, seeds 6-8, paired with E1

relation_to_earlier_plans.E1_OPUS_EXTENSION_PREREG.md: Frozen 2026-11-02 for the single Opus winner at all four E1 cells. Its frozen adapter (scripts/pair_a_to_phase1_source.py) refuses all three Opus sources; under its rule that extension is 'not executable' and stays unrun. This plan is a new, separately pre-registered study authorised on 2026-11-08: one cell (201,326,592 tokens), three frontier recipes, a documented driver mapping and a deployment step.
relation_to_earlier_plans.camera_ready_e0_e1_plan_amendment1.json: unchanged; supplies the comparator runs, the environment checks, the data identity gate and the integrity gates

order_design: Drift control first. Then seed blocks 6, 7, 8; within a block the three Opus recipes follow a cyclic Latin square (seed 6: 23, 24, 27; seed 7: 24, 27, 23; seed 8: 27, 23, 24).
held_constant_vs_E1: token stream (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 131,072, grad_accum 1: the identical loader call sequence)
seed forcing by the protected launcher
Phase-1 checkpoint evaluator, validation split, held-out shard_06541 @ 915333b4 (5,242,880 tokens)
A40 GPU-3adf8a47 and the E1 environment (re-validated by the E1 executor's validate(strict=True) before launch)

changes_required_by_the_fixed_token_prot.driver_mapping: scripts/opus_contract_t_to_phase1_source.py: Contract-T driver lines (contract_progress call, perf_counter clock, fallback time stop, NaN val_bpb placeholder, Contract-T constants and prints) restored to the panel baseline's text; the recipe's own post-training storage lines moved verbatim before the restored final evaluation. Gates: definitions byte-identical except the prepare import; statement-level changes limited to the expected set; protected transform accepts seeds 6-8; one identical driver edit for all three sources.
changes_required_by_the_fixed_token_prot.deployment_step: scripts/phase5a_export_deployed_checkpoints.py: each milestone checkpoint is converted by the recipe's own post-training storage statements (bf16 matrices; attempt 27 also int8 tables), bit-exact load/reload gates; for matrices-only recipes (23, 24) the protected loader's direct load must equal the deployed model bit for bit.
changes_required_by_the_fixed_token_prot.lr_schedule_semantics: Contract T computed LR progress as measured time / 300 s with every step counted; the fixed-token cell uses token fraction, exactly as AR-ref and AP-Q did in E1.

secondary_outcomes: milestone validation BPB at 25/50/75/100% of tokens
frozen downstream suite (LAMBADA, BLiMP, PIQA, ARC-Easy) on the final checkpoints
integrity_gates: every E1 fixed-token gate (gate_token_run, unchanged) with one substitution: the evaluator scores the deployed manifest, so the manifest-hash check is replaced by deployed-manifest provenance (each deployed checkpoint derives from this run's training milestone by sha256; deployment gates pass; evaluator hash = deployed manifest hash)
retry_policy: one retry on the same seed in a new directory; otherwise reported as failed; no seeds added

drift_control.run: AR-ref, 201,326,592 tokens, seed 6, through the E1 executor unchanged
drift_control.rule: if |held-out or validation BPB - E1 cell| > 0.005, or tokens/updates differ, every Opus-vs-comparator contrast is labelled session-confounded and reported descriptively only

downstream.checkpoints: the 9 Opus final (deployed) checkpoints and the 6 E1 201.3M final checkpoints (AP-Q and AR-ref, seeds 6-8); new database results/camera_ready_2026/phase5/A/downstream/phase5a_downstream.db

analysis_plan.primary: For each Opus recipe r: paired delta_r = heldout(r) - heldout(AR-ref) over seeds 6-8 (E1 AR-ref runs), mean and t-based 95% CI (n = 3, df = 2, t = 4.303). Holm adjustment across the 3 recipes. CI excluding 0 = confirmed difference at 201.3M tokens; otherwise inconclusive.
secondary: the same contrasts on validation BPB
mean, sd and 95% CI of every recipe at 201.3M
the August panel (seeds 3-5) as an unpaired descriptive reference only
downstream: per-recipe mean, sd and paired differences vs AR-ref and AP-Q (descriptive, no significance claims)
analysis_plan.throughput_tradeoff: steady-state training tokens/s per recipe (training_metrics) and rho_r = tok/s(r) / tok/s(AR-ref, E1 seeds 6-8). Exploratory exchange rate: k_r = the token multiple AR-ref needs to match r's held-out BPB, read from AR-ref's E1 token-response curve (88.6M, 157.3M, 201.3M; piecewise linear in ln tokens, per seed). If r's BPB lies outside AR-ref's measured range, k is reported as a bound. A recipe with rho_r > k_r would be expected to win under a fixed-time contract; this is a prediction, not a fixed-time measurement.
analysis_plan.fixed_time_vs_fixed_token: No fixed-time Opus run is made in the Phase-1 harness. Fixed-time statements cite the Pair-A campaign (seed 3, one run each) and are never called confirmed.
analysis_plan.selection_note: All three frontier recipes are reported; no selection among them.

cost_estimate.training: 9 Opus runs x ~13 min + 1 AR-ref control ~23 min = ~2.3 A40-h
